title: 2D Contour: apply finish bands to open and whole-model sources

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Extend the finish sequence from #4303 to the other existing Contour source forms.
Depend on #4303. Follow the research decisions in #4204.

Add model-edge chains, stock-source runs, disconnected selections and whole-model sources.
Complete all rings, runs and Z levels at one radial offset before starting the next offset.
Keep the existing one-chain restriction for an explicit open boundary.
Keep the existing Control and Wear refusals for open runs.

Generate every source again at each radial allowance.
Repeat air-side classification, area controls, start and exit placement, leads and stock-reach calculations.
Keep the floor allowance at S. Apply the finish allowance only to radial geometry.
Keep existing whole-model depth bands inside each radial band.
Use clearance moves between radial bands. Keep existing level links inside each band.

Evidence:
- crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:487-650.
- crates/app/src/operation/contour_open.rs, open_run.
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_run_side.rs and contour_run_stock.rs.
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_whole.rs and contour_whole_slice.rs.

Done means: tests cover every listed source, multiple rings, disconnected runs and multiple Z levels.
Every source receives the complete offset sequence and its configured leads.
A blind-floor fixture proves that changing A does not change the floor allowance.
A failed later offset fails the operation. No keep-down link crosses radial bands.
Disabled source paths remain byte-identical.

Effort: high. This work changes geometry and posted G-code. The safety floor applies.
Priority: P6. This issue extends the accepted feature design.

Part of #4204
